critique.evidence: The precedent section has zero automated WCAG violations or incomplete checks at all three viewports, no viewport overflow, no touch-target violations, no focusable controls requiring keyboard testing, and reduced-motion sampling found zero changed elements. The global header is fully keyboard reachable with visible focus indicators and has no uncontained viewport overflow. However, color contrast remains unverified: the header has one serious incomplete contrast result on tablet and 12 on mobile. Header touch-target measurements are also absent. Required proof is therefore insufficient for an 8.
critique.fix: Measure and document contrast ratios for every header link against its rendered gradient/overlap states, correcting any failures to WCAG AA. Add explicit header touch-target testing at tablet and mobile widths, including horizontally clipped navigation links, and verify targets meet the chosen WCAG target-size criterion.
